description: The chart open in the user's nymph editor: file, version, the element tree (path, type, label, id), the selected element with its written fields and the child types it takes, the data tables, the view on screen (zoom, pan) and the error the editor shows. Call first: 'this', 'the selected node' and the like mean the selection.
name: editor_state
title: Editor state

description: The whole YAML source of the chart in the editor, and its version.
name: editor_source
title: Editor source

description: One element's fields (value, written or default, allowed names), its children, the types it takes as children and the elements that name it by id.

path.description: Element path from editor_state, e.g. root/children/2.

name: editor_element
title: Editor element

description: A data table's rows as CSV text (header first), from 'offset' (row, from 0) for 'limit' rows (default 200).

table.description: Table name; omit or "" for the single unnamed table.

name: editor_table
title: Editor table

description: A PNG of the figure as the user sees it in the editor (zoom, pan, selection outline).
name: editor_view_image
title: Editor view image

description: Selects an element (and optionally one of its fields) in the editor, and/or shows a tab: 'chart' or a table name.

field.description: A field of it to focus.

tab.description: 'chart', or a table's name ("" for the single unnamed table).

name: editor_select
title: Editor select

description: Sets fields of one element as one undo step: values are strings, numbers, booleans or lists; a string starting with $ is a column reference; null clears a field back to its default. The editor checks the result like any source and refuses (changing nothing) with the loader's message.

expected_version.description: The version from editor_state: the change is refused if the user changed the chart since.

path.description: Element path, or 'image' for the image options.

name: editor_set_fields
title: Editor set fields

description: Adds an element of 'type' to 'parent' (only types the parent takes: see 'takes'). It starts valid: a fresh id, data for a series, and a link's from/to taken from the selected node and the diagram's other ids; 'fields' override them (e.g. {"from": "cart", "to": "purchases"} for a FlowLink). Returns its path and the paths that moved.

expected_version.description: The version from editor_state: the change is refused if the user changed the chart since.

fields.description: Field name to value, as editor_set_fields.

index.description: Place among the parent's children, from 0; default last.

name: editor_add_element
title: Editor add element

description: Removes an element (not the root). Refused while other elements name it by id unless 'with_references' is true, which removes those too. Returns the paths that moved.

expected_version.description: The version from editor_state: the change is refused if the user changed the chart since.

with_references.description: Also remove the elements that name it.

name: editor_remove_element
title: Editor remove element

description: Moves an element to another place among its siblings.

expected_version.description: The version from editor_state: the change is refused if the user changed the chart since.

name: editor_move_element
title: Editor move element

description: Sets cells of a data table as one undo step; a row past the end adds rows.

cells.description: Each {row (from 0), column (name or number from 0), value}.

expected_version.description: The version from editor_state: the change is refused if the user changed the chart since.

table.description: Table name; omit for the single unnamed table.

name: editor_set_cells
title: Editor set cells

description: Replaces a data table with CSV text (header first), or with create: true adds it as a new table (a second table names the first 'first_name' and its references $first_name:column).

create.description: Add the table when it does not exist.

csv.description: The table as CSV, header first.

expected_version.description: The version from editor_state: the change is refused if the user changed the chart since.

first_name.description: With create: the name the single unnamed table gets (default table1).

table.description: Table name; "" for the single unnamed table.

name: editor_set_table
title: Editor set table

description: Removes a data table (refused while elements take data from it).

expected_version.description: The version from editor_state: the change is refused if the user changed the chart since.

name: editor_remove_table
title: Editor remove table

description: Replaces the whole source (one undo step). Prefer the smaller tools; element paths may change. Takes a mermaid diagram too: it is converted to nymph YAML first.

expected_version.description: The version from editor_state: the change is refused if the user changed the chart since.

source.description: The new YAML source, or a mermaid diagram.

name: editor_set_source
title: Editor set source

description: Undoes the last change in the editor (the user's or yours).
name: editor_undo
title: Editor undo
